Workers Report Poor Implementation of Workplace Well-being Policies

A report indicates that workers are flagging the poor implementation of well-being policies in their workplaces. The findings suggest a gap between policy intent and actual practice concerning employee welfare. This issue has been highlighted by employees across various organizations. The report details concerns raised by workers regarding the effectiveness of these policies in their day-to-day work environments.
